w5Mentions.name: The Timeslot
w5Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE TIMESLOT! You're on your own.
firstContext: You wake with a start — something is wrong.
You don't know what that was. The ground, getting a new address. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ THE TIMESLOT! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
📺 SYSTEM: "COMBAT! THE TIMESLOT! The gamblers lean in. ROUND 1 — FIGHT!"

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.

◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: A stranger at the tree line, watching. Not hiding, exactly. Measuring. They'll be gone by dusk — but they'll remember what they saw.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)

w5Mentions.name: The Commercial Break
w5Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Commercial Break is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
firstContext: 🍖 FEAST 📺 — Peyton opens the pantry wide: 6× Foraged food, 3× Foraged food, 1× Foraged food. Chris, Saiful, Ivy, Meera eat until the fire burns low. Somebody tells the story again, the one everybody already knows. For one evening, hunger feels like a rumor. (−2,037 kcal from the pantry) The channe
🍖 FEASTED ×2.53 until tomorrow's dawn (6 parts left): a proper feast. A channeled keepsake feeds the flames (devotion ×1.5). Arc IV burns hotter. Strikes and abilities hit with the feast behind them.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (21/12/6), with 4 wave-4 and 3 wave-5 fought, 8 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 7 · Forage 43 → 24 · capped · Craft 8 · Talk 16 · Explore 48 → 24 · capped)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Ivy Wang ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
